features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you expend a Bardic Inspiration die: up to (Cha modifier) creatures gain Temporary Hit Points (equal to the roll) and can use their Reaction to move up to their Speed.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.desc: With 1 minute of performance, you charm your audience (Wisdom saving throw).

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you surround yourself with an aura for 1 minute: as a Bonus Action, you can cast Command without a spell slot on Charmed creatures.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute: a creature that attacks you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or it can't (its turn is wasted).
